notes: Rig variants for the Blender-guided structure pack. template = art/rigs/structures/<template>.json; params override the template defaults. Render with art/rigs/run.lua.

paint.prefix: Repaint this flat 3D clay mock-up as a finished, richly hand-painted cartoon video game scenery sprite:
paint.suffix: Keep exactly the same shape, outline, camera angle, proportions, colours and every part in the same place. Lush painterly detail like 1990s SNES racing game scenery repainted by a modern animation studio: rich painted material texture, glowing warm late-afternoon sunlight from the upper left with golden highlights and cool blue-violet shadows, gently diffused pixel-like edges. Keep the plain flat grey-blue background. No ground, no grass, no cast shadow, no text, no logos, no brand names.
paint.negative: photo, photorealistic, blurry, extra objects, people, ground, grass, trees, text, letters, watermark, logo, changed shape, flat vector
